mapper.update: /*updateMasterWmCoWarehousingDetail*/ UPDATE ICOMIVDT IVDT SET IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY = NVL(IVDT.INV_QTY, 0), IVDT.WMS_GR_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), IVDT.WMS_GR_USER_ID = #{st_user_id}, IVDT.CAR_ID = #{CAR_ID}, IVDT.CAR_NO = #{CAR_NO}, IVDT.CAR_PERSON_NAME = #{CAR_PERSON_NAME}, IVDT.CAR_PERSON_TEL = #{CAR_PERSON_TEL} , IVDT.SCHEDULED_DATE =#{SCHEDULED_DATE} WHERE IVDT.INV_NO = #{st_inv_no} AND IVDT.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND IVDT.PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND IVDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY = 0

/*updateMasterWmCoWarehousingDetail_v2*/ UPDATE ICOMIVDT IVDT SET IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY = NVL(IVDT.INV_QTY, 0), IVDT.WMS_GR_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), IVDT.WMS_GR_USER_ID = #{st_user_id}, IVDT.CAR_ID = #{CAR_ID}, IVDT.CAR_NO = #{CAR_NO}, IVDT.CAR_PERSON_NAME = #{CAR_PERSON_NAME}, IVDT.CAR_PERSON_TEL = #{CAR_PERSON_TEL} , IVDT.SCHEDULED_DATE =#{SCHEDULED_DATE} , IVDT.DELIVERY_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), IVDT.DELIVERY_QTY = NVL(IVDT.INV_QTY, 0) WHERE IVDT.INV_NO = #{st_inv_no} AND IVDT.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND IVDT.PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND IVDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY = 0
mapper.select: /*selectMasterWmCoWarehousingDetailPopORDERNO*/ Select doc_type||SUBSTR(year,3,2)||LPAD(cur_no,6,0) ORDERNO FROM Icomsqmt WHERE company= 'KRKORE0001' AND doc_type = 'IK'
